content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to transmit almost all flags (M1 to M24) from one [product_name] module to another via Ethernet. Since I can't test beforehand, I have a question. If I set up a client connection in [product_name]_1 with these properties: Operate || Length(bytes) || Address(Local) || Address(remote) Write 2 MB0 VB0, and configure [product_name]_2 as a server connection, will I be able to access the status of flag M10 by creating a network input with VB1.1 on [product_name]_2? Will this approach function correctly? Regards, [user_name]
Hello, Yes, your configuration is correct.
A new question from [user_name] was moved to a separate thread titled 'license key is missing, I can open chart of cfc v7.0.' Best regards, [user_name]
